title: Window's (and derived nodes) background panels do not scale with title_hight theme property
body: ### Tested versions Tested in 4.4 stable, 4.5 beta 3 ### System information Godot v4.4.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated Intel(R) Arc(TM) Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.6874) - Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 5 125H (18 threads) ### Issue description When creating a custom theme, a window's panel does not grow when the title_height property is changed. However, the bounding box of the window IS affected, as the mouse indicated the region where you can grab the border has moved. As there are no options for a title panel or title panel size, I assume the panel is supposed to grow but is not doing so. In this image, a theme with larger icons and font size runs off the panel but remains in-bounds: The effect can clearly be seen when setting the title_height property of FileDialog (or window) to a large value (e.g., 150) and seeing the mouse changes to the scaling icon well above the top of the bounding box. I wasn't able to capture a screenshot with my cursor visible; please see the MRP This is a problem, since when creating a theme with larger text and/or icons, I have no way to increase the bounds to encompass it. ### Steps to reproduce Create a new theme For Window (or a child), attach a theme and set the title_height property to some value larger than the default (36) Run the scene and observe that the bounding box of the window grows upwards, but not the panel. Alternatively, see the MRP attached. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [windowbug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21824561/windowbug.zip)
